  if [ -z "$FQDN" ]; then
    echo "::warning::No FQDN captured — skipping health check."
    echo "healthy=unknown" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
    exit 0
  fi
  for i in $(seq 1 6); do
    BODY=$(curl -fsS --max-time 15 "https://$FQDN/api/status" 2>/dev/null || true)
    if echo "$BODY" | grep -q '"overall":"operational"'; then
      echo "Health check passed (attempt $i/6)."
      echo "healthy=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      exit 0
    fi
    echo "Health check attempt $i/6 not operational yet, retrying in 15s..."
    sleep 15
  done
  echo "::warning::Post-deploy health check did not report operational after 6 attempts."
  echo "healthy=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
